notes: All five records were researched live against their official_source_url. Four were recovered (one awarding-body logo reused across three Ghana Scholarships Authority notices, one Institut Pascal brand lockup, one SIKAP programme mark). Every recovered asset was downloaded from the official domain and visually inspected; favicons, apple-touch-icons, og/hero article images and partner marks were rejected. No record in this shard already had an image_url, so no existing image was disturbed.

validation.notes: Taken from the record's own official_source_url, found first in the preference order. The asset is the site's own brand lockup, wired as the first element inside <a class="navbar-brand" href="/en"> on every page of the official Institut Pascal mini-site (same reference on /en), and its footer counterpart carries class="logo" and alt="Institut Pascal". Downloaded from the official domain (9618 bytes, SVG, viewBox="0 0 327.8 52.93", outlined vector paths) and rendered in a browser: it is the official horizontal lockup 'universite PARIS-SACLAY | INSTITUT PASCAL' in Paris-Saclay magenta and blue. FORMAT CAVEAT: the only full-colour official mark published on the domain is SVG; every raster probe returned HTTP 404 (styles/large/public/media/2021-07/Pascal-h.svg, media/2021-07/Pascal-h.png, 2021-07/Pascal-h.png, 2021-07/Pascal-v.png). The only raster logo on the domain, /sites/default/files/2021-07/Pascal-v-b.png (356x320, class="logo" alt="Institut Pascal"), is the white knockout variant ('b' = blanc) intended for the dark footer: downloaded and visually inspected it renders completely blank on a light background, so it is unusable as a catalogue thumbnail. The 2026 Call for Proposals publishes no programme-specific mark; this is Institut Pascal's institutional brand mark, which is the awarding body's mark named in the record's official_source field.

I searched for an Algerian programme mark and did not find one that can be tied to this award: the Algerian Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research homepage (https://www.mesrs.dz/, title 'وزارة التعليم العالي والبحث العلمي') was fetched live and contains 0 occurrences of 'bourse' and 0 of 'Ghana', and publishes no logo asset I could tie to this scholarship; only the ministry's own generic corporate mark exists there, which would be an unproven identity for this specific award. Neither a ministry mark nor an invented Algerian programme mark is proposed. If the catalogue requires the Algerian government's own mark rather than the announcing authority's, set this record to not_found.
